sloka: एतन्मे सदृशम् देवि यन्मया राघवे कृतम् ।सदृशम् तत्तु तस्यैव यदनेन कृतम् मयि ॥२-६४-६३॥
transliteration: etanme sadṛśam devi yanmayā rāghave kṛtam ।sadṛśam tattu tasyaiva yadanena kṛtam mayi ॥2-64-63॥

translations.english: Whatever I have done to the scion of the Raghu family (Rama) is befitting me, O Devi. And whatever he has done in respect of me is also worthy of him.
